title: Rookie Arc
logline: Final of the Harbor Cup skate tournament at sunset. A rookie has fallen twice, the three-time champion is laughing, and she has one run left. Her power-up is {product}.

world.rules: Every banner, scoreboard, jersey and deck is blank or solid colour. No lettering from the model; tournament name, name cards and SFX are added in post.

applied.moment: she applies it at the edge of the bowl (sunscreen, grip wax, balm) and the aura starts on her skin

worn.moment: she puts it on before the run (shoes, gloves, glasses, helmet) and the transformation sparks from it

handheld.moment: she clicks, switches on or snaps it (earbuds, tool, gadget) and the power-up begins

carried.moment: she unzips it (backpack, case) and the glow spills out

home.moment: a flashback to her room: the thing she trains with or sleeps on every night powers the memory

consumable.moment: she tears the pack or refill open at the top of the bowl and the aura bursts out

music.brief: J-rock style opening theme intro: a lone clean electric guitar riff over a muted kick, tense and wistful, in E minor, 150 bpm half-time feel; drops out under each line.
A riser and a snare roll build under the can, a full-band hit exactly on the crack, then driving drums and overdriven guitars kick in at full tempo.
The chorus: soaring lead guitar melody, double-time drums, a cut to near-silence at the peak of the air, a huge return on the landing.
The riff resolves to E major, a final power chord that rings out, like an ending theme sting.

lore: Pier Nine Bowl was poured eleven years ago inside the old fish-market loading dock on the Port Kessel waterfront; a rusted iron mooring bollard was left standing in the deep end and every local skates around it.
The Harbor Cup is in its eleventh year. The winner gets a painted silhouette on the pier's champion wall; Dax already has three.
Dax marks every title with a crimson tape stripe on the tail of his board: three stripes.
Mika has skated the pier every dawn for two years, before the dock workers arrive. The bandage on her cheek is from yesterday's semi-final slam.
She has fallen twice in the final. She has one run left, forty-five seconds, and the sun will be down in fifteen minutes.
world_bible.materials_rule: 2D anime background art: hand-painted backgrounds with visible gouache brush texture and hard-edged cel-shaded characters and props. Concrete is painted with cracks, stains, wheel scuffs and grind marks; metal has one sharp specular stripe; paint is chipped in drawn flecks; stickers are solid colour shapes (stars, circles, lightning bolts) with no writing. Light shafts, lens flares and sparkles are painted. Nothing is photoreal except the can's label, copied exactly.
